query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:51:42Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:21:42Z"
        AND host.name == "web-2"
| STATS count = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY event.action, event.outcome, message
| SORT count DESC
| LIMIT 20
